def solve3(I):
    I=I.copy(); h,w=I.shape
    lab1,n1 = ndimage.label(I==1, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=I.copy()
    for i in range(1,n1+1):
        cells=np.argwhere(lab1==i)
        rmin,cmin=cells.min(0); rmax,cmax=cells.max(0)
        # anomalies belonging to this object: anomaly cells within/at boundary of object bbox... use adjacency
        anoms=[(r,c,I[r,c]) for r,c in np.argwhere((I!=0)&(I!=1))
               if any(lab1[rr,cc]==i for rr in range(max(0,r-1),min(h,r+2)) for cc in range(max(0,c-1),min(w,c+2)))]
        if not anoms: continue
        col=min(anoms, key=lambda a: min(abs(r-a[0])+abs(c-a[1]) for r,c in cells))[2]
        for r,c in cells:
            if all(I[rr,cc]!=0 for rr in range(r-1,r+2) for cc in range(c-1,c+2)):
                out[r,c]=col
    return out
